name: Teladoc
description: Teladoc Health provides virtual medical, mental health, expert medical and chronic-condition services to eligible members through web, mobile, telephone and connected-device experiences. Its enterprise Solo platform supports hospitals and health systems with governed virtual-care workflows, clinical-system integration, care-team collaboration and purpose-built devices.
agentUseSummary: Teladoc cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because member access is personal enrollment in a PHI-bearing clinical service with no published developer API, while Solo is a separately contracted and configured enterprise-care platform. Relay will not collect member credentials, automate care, or treat a health-system sales relationship and EHR deployment as generic cloud authority.

blocked.label: Connect a Teladoc member account
blocked.description: Relay does not collect member usernames, passwords, MFA codes, eligibility information, insurance data, session cookies, device authority or clinical enrollment credentials.

blocked.label: Automate Teladoc care
blocked.description: Relay does not schedule or conduct consultations, choose clinicians, submit symptoms, request diagnoses or prescriptions, message care teams, manage treatment, order supplies or make medical decisions.

blocked.label: Access member health data
blocked.description: Relay does not read or alter medical history, consultation records, messages, measurements, prescriptions, labs, claims, insurance, connected-device readings or other protected health information through the secure member platform.

blocked.label: Control the Solo enterprise platform
blocked.description: Relay does not provision health-system tenants, EHR workflows, clinicians, virtual nursing, monitoring, devices, rooms, consults or clinical operations without a customer-specific Solo contract and approved technical interface.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No action is exposed under the Teladoc identity until an approved enterprise customer and Teladoc Health establish a bounded non-clinical integration contract for Relay.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts no Teladoc member credential, clinical workflow, health record, connected device, Solo tenant, EHR integration or care operation in OpenClaw.
Relay mounts no Teladoc member credential, clinical workflow, health record, connected device, Solo tenant, EHR integration or care operation in Hermes.

providerSetup.blocker: Teladoc member services are specific clinical programs in which an eligible individual enrolls or schedules a consultation. Teladoc's terms grant personal, limited, revocable use during the applicable enrollment or subscription and prohibit commercial reuse without written consent. Password-protected secure platforms contain protected health and medical information, and the public privacy policy expressly separates those clinical systems from public websites. Teladoc notes that a member may authorize a third-party service to access account information, but it does not publish a general developer registration, OAuth, endpoint, scope, token, schema, webhook or revocation contract that Relay can implement. Solo is a distinct enterprise virtual-care platform for hospitals and health systems, integrating EHRs, clinical workflows, care teams, AI monitoring and Teladoc devices through a governed customer deployment reached by sales contact. Enabling it requires a signed health-system agreement, tenant design, clinical governance, BAA and approved interfaces. Neither identity supports a generic self-service Relay connector, and clinical actions cannot be made safe by an approval prompt alone.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request member credentials, eligibility, insurance, medical history, symptoms, consultations, messages, prescriptions, device readings, PHI, Solo tenant details, EHR access or clinician authority; enroll in services; contact sales as the customer; authorize third-party access; automate web or mobile UI; control care; or show Connect. Reconsider only for an authorized employer, health plan or health-system customer after Teladoc Health and the customer approve Relay's exact non-clinical use case, execute required commercial, BAA and data-processing agreements, provide current official API or interoperability documentation, tenant-scoped machine credentials, test tenancy, schemas, event verification, limits, permitted data and explicit revocation. Clinical diagnosis, treatment and autonomous care decisions must remain blocked.

evidence.supports: Teladoc describes member virtual-care and chronic-condition services whose availability and coverage depend on enrollment, eligibility, benefits and the member's account.

Teladoc's member terms cover enrolled clinical services and connected programs, grant personal limited use, require account protection and written consent for commercial reuse, and describe optional member-authorized third-party access.
Teladoc distinguishes public website data from password-protected Secure Platforms where eligible members use services and where information is PHI or medical information governed by healthcare law.
Teladoc describes Solo as a governed enterprise virtual-care platform for health systems with EHR-native integrations, clinical workflows, AI monitoring and connected devices.
Teladoc routes employers, health plans and health systems through organization-specific virtual-care solutions and a contact-led relationship rather than a self-service developer connection.

Teladoc distinguishes its public informational websites from telemedicine, chronic-condition and expert medical services and states that clinical services and healthcare-provider responsibilities are separate.
